blocks.tex:
The converse constructs a polygon from a radius word. This chapter starts
with an actual polygon and its three-line circles and derives the required
sign condition. The circle convention is unchanged: adjacent contacts may lie
on line extensions, and the central contact lies in its open edge.
All indices below are cyclic modulo $n$.

blocks.label: st:forward-chords
blocks.title: Strict edge support orders every vertex triple
blocks.body:
If $Y$ has strict edge support and $a<b<c<a+n$, then
$[Y_a,Y_b,Y_c]>0$. Consequently the chord $Y_aY_b$ is strictly negative
against vertices in the cyclic interval $(a,b)$ and strictly positive against
vertices in $(b,a+n)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.crossR2_cyclic_triple_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_cyclic_triple_pos [NeZero n] {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) (i : ZMod n) {a b : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b < n) :
    0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + (a : ZMod n))) (Y (i + (b : ZMod n))) := by
  have hn : 0 < n := NeZero.pos n
  have hfront : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 < j → j < n →
      0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + 1)) (Y (i + (j : ZMod n))) := by
    intro j hj hjn
    apply hY
    · have h := cast_ne_of_lt hjn hn (by omega : j ≠ 0)
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_ne_left] using h
    · exact fun heq ↦ cast_ne_of_lt hjn (by omega : 1 < n)
        (by omega : j ≠ 1) (by simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using add_left_cancel heq)
  have hstep : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j + 1 < n →
      0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + (j : ZMod n)))
        (Y (i + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n))) := by
    intro j hj hjn
    rw [← cross_cycle]
    have h0j : i ≠ i + (j : ZMod n) := by
      intro heq
      have hc : (0 : ZMod n) = (j : ZMod n) := by
        exact add_left_cancel (by simpa only [add_zero] using heq : i + 0 = i + (j : ZMod n))
      exact cast_ne_of_lt hn (by omega : j < n) (by omega : 0 ≠ j)
        (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hc)
    have h0s : i ≠ (i + (j : ZMod n)) + 1 := by
      intro heq
      have hc : (0 : ZMod n) = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
        apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
        simpa only [add_zero, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using heq
      exact cast_ne_of_lt hn hjn (by omega : 0 ≠ j + 1) (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hc)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using hY (i + (j : ZMod n)) i h0j h0s
  by_cases ha1 : a = 1
  · subst a
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using hfront b hab hb
  · have ha2 : 1 < a := by omega
    induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact hstep a ha hb
    | succ k hak ih =>
      have hkn : k < n := by omega
      have hk1 : a < k := by omega
      exact cross_trans_in_halfplane (hfront a ha2 (by omega))
        (hfront k (by omega) hkn) (hfront (k + 1) (by omega) hb)
        (ih hkn) (hstep k (by omega) hb)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.crossR2_lifted_triple_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_lifted_triple_pos [NeZero n] {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) {a b c : ℕ}
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hca : c < a + n) :
    0 < crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y (c : ZMod n)) := by
  have h := crossR2_cyclic_triple_pos hY (a : ZMod n)
    (a := b - a) (b := c - a) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  simpa only [← Nat.cast_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le (by omega : a ≤ b),
    Nat.add_sub_of_le (by omega : a ≤ c)] using h

blocks.tex:
Fix the base vertex $A=Y_a$ and its next vertex $B=Y_{a+1}$.
Every other vertex lies in the same open left half-plane of $AB$.
Consecutive radial vectors from $A$ have positive determinants, by applying
edge support to the base vertex. To pass from consecutive to arbitrary radial
vectors, use the two-dimensional determinant identity
\[
 [A,B,V][A,U,W]=[A,B,U][A,V,W]+[A,B,W][A,U,V].
\]
If $U,V,W$ lie in the common open half-plane and the two consecutive radial
determinants are positive, the right side is positive and so is
$[A,U,W]$. Induction gives the result for any ordered pair of radial vectors;
the initial radial vector $B-A$ is handled directly by edge support.
Cyclic lifting and interchange of the last two vertices give the two chord signs.

blocks.label: st:forward-blocks
blocks.title: Absence of four signs gives two weak sign blocks
blocks.body:
Suppose $c$ has both a positive and a negative entry but no four cyclic
entries of signs $+,-,+,-$. There are lifts $a<b<a+n$ with $c_a<0<c_b$,
$c_k\le0$ for $a<k<b$, and $c_k\ge0$ for $b<k<a+n$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_sign_blocks_of_not_dfv
lean.code:
theorem exists_sign_blocks_of_not_dfv [NeZero n] {c : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < c i) (hneg : ∃ i, c i < 0) (hdfv : ¬ DFV c 0) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ, a < b ∧ b < a + n ∧ c (a : ZMod n) < 0 ∧ 0 < c (b : ZMod n) ∧
      (∀ k, a < k → k < b → c (k : ZMod n) ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ k, b < k → k < a + n → 0 ≤ c (k : ZMod n)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hpos
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hneg
  let p := i.val
  have hp : c (p : ZMod n) > 0 := by simpa only [p, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hi
  let d := (j - i).val
  have hdn : d < n := ZMod.val_lt _
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : d = 0 := by omega
    have hij : j = i := by
      have hcast : (d : ZMod n) = j - i := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
      rw [hz, Nat.cast_zero] at hcast
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hcast.symm
    rw [hij] at hj
    linarith
  have hpd : ((p + d : ℕ) : ZMod n) = j := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, p, d, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    ring
  have hfirst : ∃ k : ℕ, p < k ∧ k < p + n ∧ c (k : ZMod n) < 0 :=
    ⟨p + d, by omega, by omega, by simpa only [hpd] using hj⟩
  let a := Nat.find hfirst
  obtain ⟨hpa, hap, ha⟩ := Nat.find_spec hfirst
  have hwrap : c ((p + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) > 0 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero] using hp
  have hnext : ∃ k : ℕ, a < k ∧ 0 < c (k : ZMod n) := ⟨p + n, hap, hwrap⟩
  let b := Nat.find hnext
  obtain ⟨hab, hb⟩ := Nat.find_spec hnext
  have hbp : b ≤ p + n := Nat.find_min' hnext ⟨hap, hwrap⟩
  refine ⟨a, b, hab, by omega, ha, hb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hak hkb
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hk
    exact Nat.find_min hnext hkb ⟨hak, hk⟩
  · intro k hbk hka
    by_cases hkp : k < p + n
    · apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hk
      exact hdfv ⟨p, a, b, k, hpa, hab, hbk, hkp, hp, ha, hb, hk⟩
    · have hnk : n ≤ k := by omega
      have htk : k - n < a := by omega
      have hpt : p ≤ k - n := by omega
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ c ((k - n : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hpt with he | he
        · simpa only [← he] using hp.le
        · apply le_of_not_gt
          intro hk
          exact Nat.find_min hfirst htk ⟨he, by omega, hk⟩
      simpa only [Nat.cast_sub hnk, ZMod.natCast_self, sub_zero] using hnonneg

blocks.tex:
Start at a positive entry $p$, take the first negative entry $a$ after it,
and then the first positive entry $b$ after $a$. The positive entry at
$p+n$ guarantees that this second search ends within a period. Minimality
makes the entries between $a$ and $b$ nonpositive, and those between $p$ and
$a$ nonnegative. A negative entry between $b$ and $p+n$ would combine with
$p,a,b$ to give the forbidden alternating four. The portion after $p+n$
repeats the initial nonnegative interval. These statements retain every zero.

blocks.label: st:forward-affine-balance
blocks.title: Affine balance forces four cyclic sign changes
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge3$ and let $Y$ have strict edge support. If
$\sum_i c_i=0$ and $\sum_i c_iY_i=0$, then either all coefficients vanish or
$\operatorname{DFV}(c,0)$ holds.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.vertex_ne_of_strictSupport
lean.code:
lemma vertex_ne_of_strictSupport [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) {a b : ZMod n} (hab : a ≠ b) : Y a ≠ Y b := by
  by_cases hb : b = a + 1
  · rw [hb]
    exact (isSimplePolygon_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport hn hY).1 a
  · exact (pairwise_ne_of_crossR2_ne_zero (hY a b hab.symm hb).ne').2.2.symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sum_mul_cross_eq_zero
lean.code:
lemma sum_mul_cross_eq_zero [NeZero n] {c : ZMod n → ℝ} {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0) (hbalance : ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0) (A B : ℂ) :
    ∑ i, c i * crossR2 A B (Y i) = 0 := by
  have hre : ∑ i, c i * (Y i).re = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg Complex.re hbalance
  have him : ∑ i, c i * (Y i).im = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg Complex.im hbalance
  calc
    ∑ i, c i * crossR2 A B (Y i) =
        ∑ i, ((B - A).re * (c i * (Y i).im) - (B - A).im * (c i * (Y i).re) -
          ((B - A).re * A.im - (B - A).im * A.re) * c i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simp only [crossR2, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
      ring
    _ = 0 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hre, him, hsum, mul_zero, sub_self]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sign_block_chord_classification
lean.code:
lemma sign_block_chord_classification [NeZero n] {c : ZMod n → ℝ} {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hba : b < a + n)
    (hneg : ∀ k, a < k → k < b → c (k : ZMod n) ≤ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ k, b < k → k < a + n → 0 ≤ c (k : ZMod n)) (j : ZMod n) :
    j = (a : ZMod n) ∨ j = (b : ZMod n) ∨
      (c j ≤ 0 ∧ crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y j) < 0) ∨
      (0 ≤ c j ∧ 0 < crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y j)) := by
  let k := a + (j - (a : ZMod n)).val
  have hka : a ≤ k := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hkn : k < a + n := Nat.add_lt_add_left (ZMod.val_lt _) a
  have hkj : (k : ZMod n) = j := by
    simp only [k, Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    ring
  by_cases hka' : k = a
  · exact Or.inl (hkj.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x : ℕ ↦ (x : ZMod n)) hka'))
  have hak : a < k := lt_of_le_of_ne hka (Ne.symm hka')
  rcases lt_trichotomy k b with hkb | hkb | hbk
  · apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
    refine ⟨by simpa only [hkj] using hneg k hak hkb, ?_⟩
    have hcross := crossR2_lifted_triple_pos hY hak hkb hba
    rw [hkj] at hcross
    rw [crossR2_swap]
    exact neg_neg_of_pos hcross
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (hkj.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x : ℕ ↦ (x : ZMod n)) hkb)))
  · apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
    exact ⟨by simpa only [hkj] using hpos k hbk hkn,
      by simpa only [hkj] using crossR2_lifted_triple_pos hY hab hbk hkn⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.zero_or_dfv_of_strict_affine_balance
lean.code:
theorem zero_or_dfv_of_strict_affine_balance [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {c : ZMod n → ℝ} {Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0) (hbalance : ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0) :
    (∀ i, c i = 0) ∨ DFV c 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hzero : ∀ i, c i = 0
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  apply Or.inr
  by_contra hdfv
  have hpos : ∃ i, 0 < c i := by
    by_contra h
    have hnonpos : ∀ i, c i ≤ 0 := fun i ↦ le_of_not_gt (fun hi ↦ h ⟨i, hi⟩)
    exact hzero (fun i ↦ congrFun ((Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos hnonpos).mp hsum) i)
  have hneg : ∃ i, c i < 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have hnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i := fun i ↦ le_of_not_gt (fun hi ↦ h ⟨i, hi⟩)
    exact hzero (fun i ↦ congrFun ((Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnonneg).mp hsum) i)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hba, ha, hb, hnegative, hpositive⟩ :=
    exists_sign_blocks_of_not_dfv hpos hneg hdfv
  let F : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i ↦ crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y i)
  have hclass := sign_block_chord_classification hY hab hba hnegative hpositive
  have hprod : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i * F i := by
    intro i
    rcases hclass i with hi | hi | ⟨hc, hf⟩ | ⟨hc, hf⟩
    · simp [F, hi, crossR2, mul_comm]
    · simp [F, hi, crossR2, mul_comm]
    · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hc hf.le
    · exact mul_nonneg hc hf.le
  have hprodzero : ∀ i, c i * F i = 0 := fun i ↦ congrFun
    ((Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hprod).mp
      (sum_mul_cross_eq_zero hsum hbalance (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)))) i
  have hsupp : ∀ i, i ≠ (a : ZMod n) → i ≠ (b : ZMod n) → c i = 0 := by
    intro i hia hib
    rcases hclass i with hi | hi | ⟨_, hf⟩ | ⟨_, hf⟩
    · exact (hia hi).elim
    · exact (hib hi).elim
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprodzero i)).resolve_right hf.ne
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprodzero i)).resolve_right hf.ne'
  have hcenter : ∑ i, c i • (Y i - Y (b : ZMod n)) = 0 := by
    simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, hsum,
      zero_smul, sub_zero, hbalance]
  have hsingle : ∑ i, c i • (Y i - Y (b : ZMod n)) =
      c (a : ZMod n) • (Y (a : ZMod n) - Y (b : ZMod n)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single (a : ZMod n)
    · intro i hi hia
      by_cases hib : i = (b : ZMod n)
      · simp only [hib, sub_self, smul_zero]
      · rw [hsupp i hia hib, zero_smul]
    · simp
  rw [hsingle] at hcenter
  have habcast : (a : ZMod n) ≠ (b : ZMod n) := by
    intro heq
    rw [heq] at ha
    linarith
  exact (smul_ne_zero ha.ne (sub_ne_zero.mpr (vertex_ne_of_strictSupport hn hY habcast)))
    hcenter

deps.label: st:forward-blocks

deps.title: Strict edge support orders every vertex triple
deps.label: st:forward-chords

blocks.tex:
A nonzero zero-sum list has both signs. If no four-sign window exists, use
the two blocks separated by $a,b$. The chord functional
$F_i=[Y_a,Y_b,Y_i]$ has the same weak sign as $c_i$ at every other label,
and vanishes at $a,b$. Thus $c_iF_i\ge0$ for all $i$.
Its sum is zero: expansion of the affine functional leaves only a multiple
of $\sum c_i$ and a linear functional of $\sum c_iY_i$.
Every product therefore vanishes. Strict chord signs force $c_i=0$ away
from the two endpoints. Subtracting $Y_b\sum c_i$ from the vector balance
now gives $c_a(Y_a-Y_b)=0$. This contradicts $c_a<0$ and distinctness of
vertices, which follows from strict edge support. No generic-position or
nonzero-coefficient hypothesis was used.

blocks.label: st:forward-normal-independence
blocks.title: Adjacent outward normals are independent
blocks.body:
For an actual side-tangent realization with $n\ge3$, successive outward
normals have nonzero determinant.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.normal_cross_ne
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.normal_cross_ne (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    crossR2 0 (N (i - 1)) (N i) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, he⟩ := h.oriented_edge (i - 1)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hf⟩ := h.oriented_edge i
  simp only [sub_add_cancel] at he
  have ho := positiveOrientation_of_strictSupport hn h.strict_convex i
  have hid : crossR2 (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P (i + 1)) =
      l * m * crossR2 0 (N (i - 1)) (N i) := by
    have hs : P (i + 1) - P (i - 1) =
        (P i - P (i - 1)) + (P (i + 1) - P i) := by abel
    unfold crossR2
    rw [hs, he, hf]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, sub_zero]
    ring
  intro hc
  rw [hid, hc, mul_zero] at ho
  exact lt_irrefl 0 ho

blocks.tex:
Write the two incident edges as $\ell iN_{i-1}$ and $m iN_i$ with
$\ell,m>0$. Their determinant is
$\ell m[N_{i-1},N_i]$. Strict support makes the consecutive vertex triple
positive, so the normal determinant cannot vanish.

blocks.label: st:forward-reconstruction
blocks.title: Actual circles reconstruct a closed inverse scaling
blocks.body:
For $n\ge3$ and an actual realization $(P,N,C)$ of positive radii $\rho$, put
$Y_i=(P_i-C_i)/\rho_i$. Then
\[
 \langle N_{i-1},Y_i\rangle=\langle N_i,Y_i\rangle=1,
 \qquad Y_{i+1}-Y_i=\frac{P_{i+1}-P_i}{\rho_i}.
\]
The cyclic polygon $Y$ has strict edge support and
$\sum_i(\rho_{i-1}-\rho_i)Y_i=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_inner
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_inner
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    ⟪N (i - 1), reconstructedVertex ρ P C i⟫_ℝ = 1 ∧
      ⟪N i, reconstructedVertex ρ P C i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  simp only [reconstructedVertex, real_inner_smul_right, (h.circles i).1,
    (h.circles i).2.1, inv_mul_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', and_self]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_edge
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_edge (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    reconstructedVertex ρ P C (i + 1) - reconstructedVertex ρ P C i =
      (ρ i)⁻¹ • (P (i + 1) - P i) := by
  rw [h.reconstructed_next hn, reconstructedVertex, ← smul_sub]
  congr 1
  abel

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.reconstructedVertex
lean.code:
noncomputable def reconstructedVertex (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (P C : ZMod n → ℂ)
    (i : ZMod n) : ℂ := (ρ i)⁻¹ • (P i - C i)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_strict_balanced_polygon_of_realization
lean.code:
theorem exists_strict_balanced_polygon_of_realization (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) :
    ∃ Y : ZMod n → ℂ, StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y ∧
      ∑ i, radiusDifference ρ i • Y i = 0 := by
  let Y := reconstructedVertex ρ P C
  have hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y :=
    strictSupport_of_positive_edge_scaling hn h.strict_convex
      (fun i ↦ (ρ i)⁻¹) (fun i ↦ inv_pos.mpr (h.radius_pos i))
      (h.reconstructed_edge hn)
  refine ⟨Y, hY, ?_⟩
  have he : ∀ i, ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) = P (i + 1) - P i := by
    intro i
    rw [h.reconstructed_edge hn, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', one_smul]
  rw [show (∑ i, radiusDifference ρ i • Y i) =
      ∑ i, ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) by
        simpa only [radiusDifference] using (sum_scaled_edges ρ Y).symm]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addRight (1 : ZMod n)) P)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_next
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_next (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    reconstructedVertex ρ P C (i + 1) = (ρ i)⁻¹ • (P (i + 1) - C i) := by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero (h.normal_cross_ne hn (i + 1))
  · rw [inner_sub_right, (h.reconstructed_inner (i + 1)).1,
      real_inner_smul_right]
    have he : ⟪N (i + 1 - 1), P (i + 1) - C i⟫_ℝ = ρ i := by
      rw [add_sub_cancel_right,
        show P (i + 1) - C i = (P (i + 1) - P i) + (P i - C i) by abel,
        inner_add_right, h.normal_edge_orthogonal, (h.circles i).2.1, zero_add]
    rw [he, inv_mul_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', sub_self]
  · rw [inner_sub_right, (h.reconstructed_inner (i + 1)).2,
      real_inner_smul_right, (h.circles i).2.2,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', sub_self]

deps.title: The edge normals really support the realized polygon
deps.label: st:outward-normals

deps.title: Positive closed edge scaling retains strict support
deps.label: st:scaled-support

deps.title: Balance is exactly the edge-closure equation
deps.label: st:scaled-closure

blocks.tex:
The first two circle equations give the normalized inner products.
At vertex $i+1$, the vector $(P_{i+1}-C_i)/\rho_i$ has inner product one
with both $N_i$ and $N_{i+1}$. For $N_i$, transport the equation along its
orthogonal edge; for $N_{i+1}$, use the third circle equation directly.
The two normals are independent, so these two equations determine a unique
vector: it equals $Y_{i+1}$. Subtraction proves the inverse edge-scaling law.
The vertices are already a cyclic list, so this positive scaling is closed;
the positive-scaling support lemma supplies strict support. Multiplying by
$\rho_i$, summing the edge equations, and applying cyclic summation by parts
gives the claimed exact balance. Thus the auxiliary geometry is produced
from the input circles, not assumed as a further hypothesis.

blocks.label: st:forward
blocks.title: Wegner's condition for the actual radii
blocks.body:
For $n\ge3$, the radii of any actual side-tangent realization are positive
and are either constant or have four cyclic sign changes in
$c_i=\rho_{i-1}-\rho_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sideTangentForward
lean.code:
theorem sideTangentForward [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) :
    SideTangentAdmissible ρ := by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hb⟩ := exists_strict_balanced_polygon_of_realization hn h
  refine ⟨h.radius_pos, ?_⟩
  rcases zero_or_dfv_of_strict_affine_balance hn hY (sum_radiusDifference ρ) hb with hz | hd
  · exact Or.inl (constant_of_radiusDifference_eq_zero hz)
  · exact Or.inr hd

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.constant_of_radiusDifference_eq_zero
lean.code:
lemma constant_of_radiusDifference_eq_zero [NeZero n] {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ i, radiusDifference ρ i = 0) : ∃ r, ∀ i, ρ i = r := by
  have hsucc : ∀ i, ρ (i + 1) = ρ i := by
    intro i
    have hi := h (i + 1)
    simp only [radiusDifference, add_sub_cancel_right, sub_eq_zero] at hi
    exact hi.symm
  have hnat : ∀ k : ℕ, ρ (k : ZMod n) = ρ 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp only [Nat.cast_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using (hsucc (k : ZMod n)).trans ih
  exact ⟨ρ 0, fun i ↦ by simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hnat i.val⟩

deps.title: Actual circles reconstruct a closed inverse scaling
deps.label: st:forward-reconstruction

deps.title: Cyclic relabeling and the four ordered witnesses
deps.label: st:cyclic-labels

deps.title: Affine balance forces four cyclic sign changes
deps.label: st:forward-affine-balance

blocks.tex:
The radius differences have zero total sum, and the reconstructed strictly
supported polygon gives zero vector sum. Apply the affine-balance lemma.
If all differences vanish, $\rho_{i-1}=\rho_i$ at every label; induction over
one period makes the radius word constant. Otherwise the conclusion is
exactly the required four-sign window. Positivity is part of the actual
realization certificate.

blocks.label: st:iff
blocks.title: Exact characterization of side-tangent radius words
blocks.body:
For $n\ge4$, a cyclic real word is realized by the inward three-supporting-line
circles of a simple strictly convex polygon with open central contacts if and
only if it is positive and is constant or has four sign changes in its cyclic
first differences. For positive nonconstant data the constant alternative is
omitted.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    RealizesSideTangent ρ ↔ SideTangentAdmissible ρ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, N, C, h⟩
    exact sideTangentForward (by omega) h
  · exact sideTangentConverse hn ρ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_iff_dfv
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_iff_dfv [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hnc : ¬ ∃ r, ∀ i, ρ i = r) :
    RealizesSideTangent ρ ↔ DFV (radiusDifference ρ) 0 := by
  rw [realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible hn]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2.resolve_left hnc, fun h ↦ ⟨hρ, Or.inr h⟩⟩

deps.title: Wegner's condition for the actual radii
deps.label: st:forward

blocks.tex:
Necessity is the preceding theorem; sufficiency is the side-tangent converse.
For nonconstant data, the constant disjunct is impossible. The definition of
admissibility is unchanged on the two sides, so this combines the actual
geometric producer with its actual converse.
